bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 30-September-2025 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior 31-December-2024 audited position -- the 31-Dec-2024 comparative column in this document matches the bank's own FY2024 annual report EXACTLY on every figure checked (total_equity 11,045,530,488; classified loans 14,332,622,928; provision deficit on loans-and-advances 6,558,390,257), confirming this filing is on the same basis and free of restatement vs the audited FY2024 figures already in this dataset. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (the statement's own leftmost 'Ol Jan 2025 to 30 September 2025' column), matching the _cumulative convention used elsewhere in this dataset (e.g. CITYBANK). The source document ALSO prints a separate discrete 'Ol July to 30 September 2025' (Q3-only) column; the three most decision-relevant discrete-quarter figures are captured below as supplementary *_discrete_quarter fields because they materially change the picture: Q3-2025-only profit before tax was Tk.148.83m and PAT was only Tk.3.876m (EPS 0.005), already very weak, but comparing the 9-month cumulative figures here (PBT 447.69m, PAT 117.69m) against the already-known FY2025 ANNUAL figures (PBT 207.20m, PAT 6.50m, both from 2025_Q4.json) implies Q4-2025-ALONE (annual minus this 9-month cumulative) swung to a PRE-TAX LOSS of approximately Tk.240.49m and a NET LOSS of approximately Tk.111.19m, with total provision charge alone in Q4 (~Tk.340.21m, implied) exceeding the combined Q1-Q3 provision charge (Tk.526.71m over 9 months, i.e. Q4's single-quarter charge was about 65% of the prior three quarters combined) -- i.e. the year swung from a modestly profitable 9 months to a near-breakeven full year almost entirely because of a Q4 collapse in profitability, concentrated in provisioning. However, ASSET QUALITY itself was already deteriorating well before Q4: classified loans (Solo, Note 8.11) were Tk.17,977.00m at 30-Sep-2025 vs Tk.14,332.62m at 31-Dec-2024 (+25.4% in nine months alone), and the Solo NPL ratio had already reached 19.80% (17,977.00m/90,772.41m) by Q3, barely below the 19.87% Consolidated-basis figure recorded for FY2025 year-end in 2025_Q4.json -- so the NPL RATIO rose steadily and was already almost at its full-year level by Q3, while the PROFIT/PROVISIONING hit was deferred and concentrated into Q4 (the qualified-audit-opinion quarter). The loans-and-advances-only required-provision shortfall (Note 8.10; narrower than the auditor's FY2025 'all categories' Tk.10,235.7m headline figure, which additionally includes NBFI placements) was ALREADY Tk.8,019.93m at 30-Sep-2025 (required 13,446.78m vs maintained 5,426.85m), up 22.3% from Tk.6,558.39m at FY2024 year-end -- confirming the shortfall grew progressively through the year rather than appearing suddenly at Q4/audit. Note 8.10 also quotes a specific regulatory-forbearance letter: 'the Department of Off-site Supervision of Bangladesh Bank through letter reference no. DOS (CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2025-3115 dated 22 May 2025, allowed finalization of Financial Statements for the year 2024 without adjustment of the rest provision' -- i.e. Bangladesh Bank explicitly permitted the Bank to publish FY2024 financials without fully providing for the already-disclosed shortfall, which helps explain how a 'profit' was still reported in FY2024 despite the gap being known. Capital adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosures are NOT part of this quarterly unaudited financial statement (no Basel III Pillar III page in this filing, unlike the annual report) and are left as a gap for this and other interim quarters in this dataset. Equity components (paid-up capital, statutory reserve, other/revaluation reserve, foreign currency translation reserve, retained earnings) sum EXACTLY to total_equity when 'foreign currency translation reserve' (Note 16.2, printed as a distinct line from 'other reserve' Note 16 in this document) is included as its own line -- note that SBACBANK's own 2025_Q4.json does not separately break out this FX-translation-reserve line item (its four equity components there sum to ~26.4m less than its stated total_equity), which this quarterly filing suggests is very likely the missing FX-translation-reserve line rather than an error, though FY2025_Q4.json itself is not altered here per scope rules. Original PDF was a 62-page scanned/image-based board-agenda-style document (pdftotext extracted to ~0 usable lines); all figures below were read directly off 300dpi-rendered page images (OCR used only for page-location triage), per project OCR policy.
